query: AWS revenue growth year over year latest quarter AI workloads
normalized: ai aws growth over quarter revenue workloads year

output.content:
In Amazon’s latest reported quarter, **Q2 2026 ended June 30, AWS revenue was $42.2 billion, up 36.7% year over year** (reported as 37%), its fastest growth rate in 18 quarters; this equates to a **$169 billion annualized run rate**. [[1]] [[2]] 

AI workloads appear to be a material driver: Amazon said AWS’s AI business exceeded a **$25 billion annual revenue run rate** and grew at a **triple-digit year-over-year rate**. [[2]]

sources.title: Amazon.com, Inc. - Amazon.com Announces Second Quarter Results
